thread:
mira (partnerships): Heads-up — planning a compact joint demo with SigmaCompute (HW) + Nimbus SI + LangChain wiring for the marketplace listing. Goal: small end-to-end flow we can run in the sandbox and record for partner marketing.
jonas (devrel): Love it. What's the scope? quick LLM prompt -> retriever (LlamaIndex) -> tool call to the gateway -> inference on Sigma nodes?
mira (partnerships): Exactly. Minimal happy path: user query -> LangChain chain that hits LlamaIndex on our ingest -> gateway routes to Redwood Dedicated on Sigma GPU, return structured JSON, show token/latency dashboard.
alex (eng): Tech checklist: 1) prebuilt sample repo + Dockerfile 2) env var examples for gateway auth 3) small eval prompt set 4) tracing tags for console. I can spin the repo.
samir (solutions): I can draft the walkthrough script for the demo and the partner-facing README. Need the exact gateway config snippet to show in the playbook.
alice (sales): Partners asked for a co-branded one-pager and a short clip (30–60s). Can we commit to a recording slot next Wed?
jonas (devrel): Wed works if we freeze the sample code by EOD Mon. I'll produce a LangChain template using the AgentExecutor + retriever call. Will add comment blocks.
mira (partnerships): Great. Alex — can you paste the gateway config we should show? include auth header and region fallback.
alex (eng): Sure — use this minimal snippet (for demo only):
```
REDWOOD_API_KEY=redacted_demo_key
GATEWAY_URL=https://gateway.sandbox.sigmacompute.com/v1
REGION_PREFERENCE=us-west-2
```
And note: don't leak real keys in the demo.
samir (solutions): For the LlamaIndex connector, add this note: set chunk_size=512 and precompute embeddings with our small-embed model to keep costs down.
jonas (devrel): I'll wire example prompt templates and an eval harness. Also will add a one-click button to launch the sandbox using the partner's test creds (placeholder).
amira (partnerships): @alice typo — meant @mira :)
alice (sales): lol noted. But thinking about marketplace assets — we need a short summary for the listing: 2–3 bullets, supported models/hardware, and SLA blurb. I'll draft and share.
mira (partnerships): Timeline: Mon EOD code freeze, Tue walkthrough + dry run, Wed recording. Is that feasible?
alex (eng): Feasible. I'll post the demo repo link in this thread by EOD today.
jonas (devrel): Can we add a tiny script to simulate traffic so we can show latency breakdown in Console? e.g., k6 or a simple loop.
samir (solutions): I'll add the script and a short README section: "How to show cost/latency in Console" with screenshots.
deploy-bot: deployment queued: sandbox-demo-stack to sigma-sandbox (build #428).
mira (partnerships): Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll coordinate NDA/marketing check with Nimbus and Sigma and share co-brand assets once legal signs off. If anything blocks, flag here. :thumbsup:
